root_causes.description: The shipping service shows a severe tail-latency spike (server p99 ~9.2s, p95 ~7.6s vs ~2ms median) with zero errors and no CPU/restart anomalies. Because checkout and frontend call shipping synchronously, this latency propagates and inflates the p99 of the whole checkout path.

evidence.expected_baseline: p99 ~2ms; p50 remains 1.98ms and other leaf services p99 <10ms

evidence.observed_value: search_traces(shipping, min_duration_ms>3000): 9 traces, 0 errors, p95_duration=58915ms; bde22f47e5420fec user_checkout_single 8931ms ok; 1c72f2d0552bbf3a order-consumed 42951ms ok
evidence.expected_baseline: shipping server span p95 well under 100ms
no error logs; confirms latency, not error, fault

evidence.query_or_id: Updated: Successfully update ObservedGeneration and FailedMessage of resource (count=1)
evidence.observed_value: only routine update events for shipping pods, no crashes/OOM/kill

root_causes.description: Checkout's server p99 balloons to ~9.9s while its error rate, CPU usage, and leaf-dependency latencies (payment, cart, currency, email, product-catalog) remain normal. The elevation is downstream propagation from shipping rather than an intrinsic checkout fault.

evidence.observed_value: error_rate mean=0.008 p99=0.019 max=0.019, no anomaly

evidence.expected_baseline: stable checkout CPU, ruling out cpu_stress
leaf dependencies normal, isolating the delay to shipping

root_causes.description: Frontend p99 rises to ~8.2s with no errors, consistent with being the entry point that fans out to the slow shipping/checkout path. This is an upstream symptom, not the origin.

evidence.expected_baseline: frontend p99 in the low hundreds of ms

remediation_steps: Inspect the shipping pod for CPU throttling, GC pauses, thread-pool exhaustion, or blocked I/O; its own dependency quote is normal (p99=1.98ms), so the stall originates inside shipping.
Check shipping container-level resource limits and memory working set, and review its logs around 14:29-14:32 UTC for repeated slow operations.
Add/enforce a timeout and circuit breaker on checkout->shipping and frontend->shipping calls to cap propagated p99 while the root cause is fixed.
Consider scaling shipping replicas to dilute the tail latency.
Verify recovery by confirming shipping server p99 returns to ~2ms and checkout/frontend p99 drop back to baseline.
Correlate the 14:29 UTC latency onset with any recent shipping deployment or flagd flag change.
